title: Image compression for Mac
lead: Drop images or a folder. PixMinima searches for a smaller file, verifies it and replaces the original in place. Compression is lossless by default.
requirements: Apple silicon · macOS 27 Golden Gate or later
fidelity: Maximum effort tries more encodings. To allow changes to the image, enable lossy compression in Settings. It is off when you first open the app.
results: Size shows the final file size. Savings shows the percentage saved. Click a column heading to sort the batch.
write: The default replaces originals without a backup. Settings also offer separate copies or a restorable backup. All image processing runs on your Mac.
install1: Download the disk image and open it.
install2: Drag PixMinima to Applications, then open the app.
install3: Drop the files you want to process, then choose “Optimize and replace”.
updates: PixMinima checks for updates automatically. You can also check from Settings and choose when to restart.
author: Made by Alejandro San Martin Lamas.
alt: PixMinima shows the final size and percentage saved for each file.
description: PixMinima compresses images on your Mac. Lossless by default, with optional lossy compression, per-file results and open source code.
appLanguages: The Mac app is available in English, French and Spanish.
